tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. White on light, near-black on dark. The storefront's default surface.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet bands and wells: alternating storefront sections, the admin canvas behind cards, table headers, the message block inside an inquiry.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, inputs, menus and dialogs sitting on `bg` or `bg-subtle`. The same white as `bg` on light, where a `line` border separates them; one step lighter than `bg` on dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `bg-subtle`, `bg-raised`, `accent-soft` and the soft status tints. Also the fill of solid buttons, selected chips and the heavy rules; a label on an `ink` fill is `bg`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `bg`, `bg-subtle`, `bg-raised` and `accent-soft`: descriptions, helper copy, table meta, inactive tabs and nav links.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Lowest text step on `bg`, `bg-subtle` and `bg-raised`: placeholders, timestamps, decorative icons. It still holds 4.5:1, but keep it off anything a person must read to act.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card and table outlines, dividers, the hover fill of sidebar items and ghost buttons. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges at rest: inputs, selects, checkboxes, chips and the off switch track. Holds 3:1 on `bg`, `bg-subtle` and `bg-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Volt, the one brand hue, used as a FILL: the primary button, checked boxes and switches, the active sidebar item, the highlighted chart bar, a highlighter behind a key number. Text on it is `on-accent`. Never text or a hairline on light grounds (1.25:1 on white): that job belongs to `accent-ink`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an `accent` fill: a little deeper on light, a little brighter on dark. Label stays `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label, icon and switch thumb on an `accent` or `accent-hover` fill. Ink in both themes, never white.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: The accent wherever it has to carry a line, a small mark or text by itself on `bg`, `bg-subtle` and `bg-raised`: the 2px edge around volt fills, the rule under the active tab and nav link, link text, the selected-row marker. Ink on light, where volt cannot hold 3:1; volt on dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected table rows and quiet highlights. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus color, an alias of `accent-ink`. The `focus-ring` shadow draws 2px of it outside a 2px gap in the page color.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status as text, icon or badge edge on `bg`, `bg-subtle`, `bg-raised` and `success-soft`: In stock, Replied, retention up. A teal, so it is never mistaken for the volt accent. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of success badges, alerts and positive deltas. Text on it is `success` or `ink`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution as text, icon or badge edge on `bg`, `bg-subtle`, `bg-raised` and `warning-soft`: Low stock, Awaiting reply. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of warning badges and alerts. Text on it is `warning` or `ink`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions on `bg`, `bg-subtle`, `bg-raised` and `danger-soft`: field errors, Out of stock, retention down, and the fill of the delete button (label `on-danger`). A red-orange set against the teal `success`, so the pair survives red-green color blindness. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of danger badges, alerts and negative deltas. Text on it is `danger` or `ink`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a `danger` fill. White on light; ink on dark, where `danger` lightens.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices as text, icon or badge edge on `bg`, `bg-subtle`, `bg-raised` and `info-soft`: tips, Draft, system messages.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of info badges and alerts. Text on it is `info` or `ink`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The veil between a dialog and the page behind it.

families.mono: "Chivo Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Big Shoulders, always uppercase, weights 800 and 900 only. The file carries an optical-size axis: leave font-optical-sizing on auto so small labels get the open text cut.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero headline, once per page. Drop to `display-lg` under 760px wide.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section headings; the page title inside the admin.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Panel, dialog and empty-state titles; prices on product cards.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The numeral on a stat card. One number, with its unit at half size.

styles.name: action
styles.usage: Button labels, nav links and tabs.

styles.name: action-sm
styles.usage: Small buttons, chips, badges and table headers.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Archivo, sentence case. Body never below 16px on the storefront; nothing below 12px anywhere.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Vending machines, fitness supplements and drinks, from one distributor.
styles.usage: The paragraph directly under a display headline. One per section.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Product names, a client's name on an inquiry, list item headings. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tell us what you need and where it is going, and we will send you a quote.
styles.usage: Running copy and input text. Keep lines under 70 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Shown in the catalog. Clients can ask for a quote.
styles.usage: Table cells, helper and error text, card descriptions, dense admin copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, sidebar items, menu items.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase overline above a headline, the category on a product card, the label on a stat card.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines and footnotes. The smallest text in the system.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Chivo Mono for anything a person compares digit by digit.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: SKUs, prices and quantities in tables, email addresses and phone numbers on an inquiry.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Chart ticks, counts in tabs and chips, deltas on stat cards, timestamps.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use the step, never a value in between.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge; gap between stacked sidebar items.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; gap between a field's label, control and hint; gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of inputs and chips; table cell padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card body padding; table cell padding (horizontal); gap between cards in a grid on small screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel, stat card, dialog and inquiry padding; horizontal padding of a default button.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; gap between tabs and nav links; page gutter on small screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content; admin page padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; the gutter that holds chart axis labels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked blocks inside a storefront section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a storefront section on small screens.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a storefront section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the hero.

radius.note: Tight corners. Nothing rounder than 8px except pills.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, chips, badges, checkboxes, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, dialogs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large media only: hero images and product photography shown outside a card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch track and thumb, status dots, count pills. Never buttons.

border.note: Borders do the work shadows do elsewhere. Three weights.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Hairlines in `line`: card and table outlines, dividers; input edges at rest in `line-strong`.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Every button edge, the `accent-ink` edge around volt fills, the rule under a table header, the dialog outline, the chart baseline.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: The heavy rule: the top edge of a stat card, the rule under the active tab and nav link, the selected-row marker.

size.note: Control heights and the fixed widths of the two surfaces.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and chips: table row actions, filters.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects and sidebar items.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons on the storefront and the height of a tab.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum width of storefront content.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Maximum width of forms and long copy.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the admin sidebar.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control: the whole control at 45%, no change of hue.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The sticky storefront nav and sticky table headers.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Alerts that float above a dialog.

motion.note: Short and plain. Durations by job, never a value in between. Move with opacity and transform; only expand and collapse change layout. Under prefers-reduced-motion the distance, scale and stagger tokens fall to zero (see bundle.css), so movement stops and state changes stay.

tokens.name: duration-feedback
tokens.usage: Hover, press and selection on buttons, chips, fields, switches, tabs and cards.

tokens.name: duration-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and dialogs opening, accordions, the tab rule, alerts and errors appearing.

tokens.name: duration-exit
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus closing. Leaving is quicker than arriving.

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: The hero on load and a section's first entrance. Once each, never on the way back.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Interaction feedback: color, border and the 1px press.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving: entrances, dialogs, menus, alerts. Fast start, soft landing, no overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving: dialogs and menus closing.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Expand and collapse: accordion answers.

tokens.name: motion-shift
tokens.usage: How far the hero's lines travel up into place.

tokens.name: motion-shift-sm
tokens.usage: How far a dialog, menu or alert travels into place.

tokens.name: motion-scale-media
tokens.usage: A product photo on card hover, inside the card's edge. Pointer devices only.

tokens.name: stagger-step
tokens.usage: Delay between items entering together, such as the hero's lines.

tokens.name: stagger-max
tokens.usage: The longest any staggered item waits, however many there are.

shadow.note: The system is flat. Shadows exist only for things that float, plus the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers, which also keep a `line` border.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, which also keep their 2px `ink` outline.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the page color, then 2px of `focus` (a box-shadow, so it follows the radius). The two hexes per theme are that theme's `bg` and `focus` values; change them together.
